title: I am I don't etc.
summary: Короткие ответы и сокращения: **Yes, I am. / No, I don't. / She isn't, but he is.** Повторять всё предложение не нужно: достаточно вспомогательного глагола.
ru:
## Не повторяем лишнее
В русском мы отвечаем «Да, умею» или «Нет, не люблю». В английском то же самое: после вспомогательного глагола остальное не повторяем.
> Are you tired? — Yes, **I am**. — Ты устал? — Да.
> Do you like jazz? — No, **I don't**. — Ты любишь джаз? — Нет.
> I haven't got a car, but my sister **has**. — У меня нет машины, а у сестры есть.

## Какие слова можно использовать
am/is/are, was/were, have/has, do/does/did, can, could, will, would, must, should, might.
> A: Can you swim? B: Yes, I **can**.
> A: Did he phone? B: No, he **didn't**.
> A: Will she come? B: She **might**.
> A: Are you going now? B: Yes, I'm afraid I **must**.

## Утвердительный ответ: полная форма
В утвердительном ответе **нельзя** сокращать (’m, ’s, ’ve).
> Are you ready? — Yes, I **am**. (не ~~Yes, I'm.~~)
> Is he a doctor? — Yes, he **is**. (не ~~Yes, he's.~~)
> Have you got a pen? — Yes, I **have**. (не ~~Yes, I've.~~)
> She isn't tired but he **is**. (не ~~but he's~~)
Отрицательные краткие формы допустимы: **No, I'm not. / No, he isn't. / No, I haven't.**

## Контраст: утверждение и отрицание
> Sam likes tea, but I **don't**. — Сэм любит чай, а я нет.
> I don't like tea, but Sam **does**. — Я не люблю чай, а Сэм любит.
> She's here, but they **aren't**. — Она здесь, а их нет.

## Какой вспомогательный глагол выбрать
Смотрите на глагол в вопросе или в первой части:
- is / are / am → **is / are / am**
- like, work, play → **do / does**
- liked, worked → **did**
- can → **can**; will → **will**

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~Yes, I'm.~~ → Yes, **I am**.
- ~~Do you like it? — Yes, I like.~~ → Yes, **I do**.
- ~~Can she cook? — No, she don't.~~ → No, she **can't**.
- ~~Yes, I do.~~ в ответ на Are you ...? → Yes, **I am**.
en:
## We don't repeat everything
In short answers we use only the auxiliary verb. We don't repeat the rest.
> Are you tired? — Yes, **I am**.
> Do you like jazz? — No, **I don't**.
> I haven't got a car, but my sister **has**.

## Which verbs can we use?
am/is/are, was/were, have/has, do/does/did, can, could, will, would, must, should, might.
> A: Can you swim? B: Yes, I **can**.
> A: Did he phone? B: No, he **didn't**.
> A: Will she come? B: She **might**.
> A: Are you going now? B: Yes, I'm afraid I **must**.

## Positive answers: no short forms
In positive answers we cannot use 'm, 's, 've.
> Are you ready? — Yes, I **am**. (not ~~Yes, I'm.~~)
> Is he a doctor? — Yes, he **is**.
> Have you got a pen? — Yes, I **have**.
> She isn't tired but he **is**.
Negative short forms are fine: **No, I'm not. / No, he isn't. / No, I haven't.**

## Contrast
> Sam likes tea, but I **don't**.
> I don't like tea, but Sam **does**.
> She's here, but they **aren't**.

## Which auxiliary?
- is / are / am → **is / are / am**
- like, work, play → **do / does**
- liked, worked → **did**
- can → **can**; will → **will**

## Common mistakes
- ~~Yes, I'm.~~ → Yes, **I am**.
- ~~Do you like it? — Yes, I like.~~ → Yes, **I do**.
- ~~Can she cook? — No, she don't.~~ → No, she **can't**.
structure:
## Краткие ответы
| Вопрос | Да | Нет |
|---|---|---|
| Are you ...? | Yes, I am. | No, I'm not. |
| Is he ...? | Yes, he is. | No, he isn't. |
| Do you ...? | Yes, I do. | No, I don't. |
| Does she ...? | Yes, she does. | No, she doesn't. |
| Did they ...? | Yes, they did. | No, they didn't. |
| Have you ...? | Yes, I have. | No, I haven't. |
| Can he ...? | Yes, he can. | No, he can't. |
| Will you ...? | Yes, I will. | No, I won't. |

## Контраст в одном предложении
| Первая часть | Вторая часть |
|---|---|
| I like tea, | but she doesn't. |
| I don't like tea, | but she does. |
| He can swim, | but I can't. |
| We were late, | but they weren't. |

## Формула
> Yes / No, + подлежащее + **вспомогательный глагол** (am, is, do, did, can, have ...)

## Запомните
- нельзя: ~~Yes, I'm / Yes, he's / Yes, I've~~; нужно: **Yes, I am / Yes, he is / Yes, I have**;
- вопрос с **do/does/did** → ответ с **do/does/did**; вопрос с **be** → ответ с **be**.

exercises.title: Короткие ответы
exercises.instruction: Дайте короткий ответ. Подумайте, какой вспомогательный глагол нужен.

items.text: Do you like pizza? — Yes, {{I do}}.
Is your brother a student? — No, {{he isn't|he's not}}.
Did she call you yesterday? — No, {{she didn't|she did not}}.
Are they at home? — Yes, {{they are}}.
Have you got a bike? — No, {{I haven't|I have not}}.

exercises.title: Но...
exercises.example: I like coffee, but my sister **doesn't**.

items.text: Anna can play the piano, but I {{can't|cannot}}.
I don't like fish, but my brother {{does}}.
He has a car, but we {{don't|do not}}.
She hasn't got a phone, but he {{has}}.

items.why: В утвердительном ответе краткая форма не используется: **Yes, I am**.

items.q: Did you see the film? — No, ___.
Have they got a house? — Yes, ___.
I'm not tired, but my friends ___.
I work on Sundays, but my sister ___.

items.prompt: Did you go to work yesterday? (No)
I like tea. / My friend doesn't like tea.
answers: I like tea, but my friend doesn't.
I like tea but my friend doesn't.

items.prompt: I can't swim. / My brother can swim.
answers: I can't swim, but my brother can.
I can't swim but my brother can.

items.prompt: She is at home. / He isn't at home.
answers: She is at home, but he isn't.
She is at home but he isn't.
She's at home, but he isn't.
She's at home but he isn't.

items.prompt: We went to the party. / They didn't go to the party.
answers: We went to the party, but they didn't.
We went to the party but they didn't.

items.prompt: I haven't got a car. / My sister has got a car.
answers: I haven't got a car, but my sister has.
I haven't got a car but my sister has.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Ответьте коротко и добавьте одно предложение с **but**. Проверьте по образцу.

items.prompt: Do you like coffee? (about you and a friend)
items.sample: Yes, I do, but my friend doesn't.

items.prompt: Can you cook? (about you and your mum)
items.sample: No, I can't, but my mum can.
Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.

items.prompt: Have you got a dog or a cat?
items.sample: I haven't got a dog, but my friend has.
